# /vendor — Vendor marketplace management and third-party provider onboarding

Vendor marketplace management and third-party provider onboarding.

## Usage

```bash
// turbo
mekong vendor $ARGUMENTS
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `onboard` | Register a new vendor in the marketplace. |
| `list` | List all registered vendors. |
| `delist` | Remove a vendor from the marketplace. |
